description: Authenticated consumer acceptance or rejection of one exact post-official adjustment. It does not alter the original official revision or its receipt.

observed_adjustment_sha256.description: Digest recomputed from the adjustment using its canonical evidence rule.

supersedes_reporting_receipt_id.description: Optional immutable rejected receipt replaced by this new receipt for the same adjustment. Accepted current receipts are terminal.

title: Reporting Adjustment Receipt

x-adcp-validation.acceptance_match: accepted requires observed_adjustment_sha256 to equal the referenced adjustment's canonical_adjustment_sha256 and adjusts_reporting_revision_id to equal its target. A digest or semantic disagreement is rejected with stable rejection_codes.
x-adcp-validation.authorization: Derive consumer identity from authenticated transport. The adjustment and its official revision must be visible to that caller/account; unavailable and unauthorized identifiers are indistinguishable.
x-adcp-validation.immutability: A reporting_receipt_id is immutable. Exact retries are idempotent; reuse with different content is a conflict. A new ID may supersede only the current rejected receipt for this adjustment; history remains append-only and an accepted current leaf is terminal.
